answer_1.quote: We propose an automated pipeline that can generate contrast sets via verb and human entity manipulation… We leverage a generative T5 language model to manipulate the verb phrase…
answer_1.outputs: Generated alternative video captions (contrast sentences) with swapped entities or altered verb phrases

answer_2.quote: We calculate perplexity score of original and manipulated sentence using GPT2-XL… The semantic inconsistency constraints are satisfied if the word embedding of the lemmatized verbs … have cosine similarity score lower than 0.4, and the sentence embeddings have cosine similarity score lower than 0.8.

answer_3.quote: We calculate perplexity score of original and manipulated sentence using GPT2-XL, which we call ppl_o and ppl_m… candidates are kept if ppl_diff < 0.6 or ppl_diff < 1.4 ∩ ppl_m < 750.

answer_4.quote: We use the Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) platform and ask workers to modify a verb phrase such that a sentence becomes inconsistent with a video… Humans maintain accuracy greater than 90% on both contrast sets.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are instructed to rewrite verb phrases to make the caption inconsistent with the video and to select the correct caption among multiple choices.
